cvStructure.issue: Your contact details don't include a LinkedIn, GitHub, or portfolio link, which recruiters and ATS typically expect for Computing and IT roles.
cvStructure.suggestion: Add a LinkedIn profile or a GitHub/portfolio link next to your email and phone number, and also write the full web address as visible text so every system can read it.

keywordUsage.issue: Your Skills section lists tools and libraries but doesn't name the broader skill areas your Summary and projects already show, such as Machine Learning, Deep Learning, and Computer Vision.
keywordUsage.suggestion: Add Machine Learning, Deep Learning, and Computer Vision to your Skills section so ATS systems scanning for these terms can match your profile.

readability.issue: Your Summary is written as a first-person story ("I enjoy turning messy data into working models and want to start my career...") instead of a professional summary.
readability.suggestion: Rewrite the Summary without "I", for example starting with "Computer Science graduate with experience in machine learning and computer vision" and stating your goal in the same style.

readability.issue: The dashboard bullet under Data Analyst Intern ("Built weekly sales dashboards for the operations manager and explained the trends in short written reports") has no specific result.
readability.suggestion: Add a measurable detail if you have one, such as [number] of weekly dashboards delivered or [percentage/hours] saved in reporting time.

contentFormatting.issue: Dates are written in different styles across your CV: Experience uses Month Year (Jun 2025 - Aug 2025), Education, Projects, and Certifications use only the year, and Activities places years in parentheses.
contentFormatting.suggestion: Use one consistent date format everywhere, such as Month Year, for example writing your Education dates as Aug 2022 - Jun 2026.
